back_translation: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.

Say to the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord GOD. The Lord GOD says this: Because you cried ‘Aha!’ mocking My sanctuary when it was profaned, mocking the land of Israel when it was laid waste, and mocking the house of Judah when they went into exile,
therefore, behold, I will give you as a possession to the people of the East. They will set up their camps and pitch their tents among you; they will eat your fruit and drink your milk.
I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels and the land of the Ammonites a fold for sheep. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’
For the Lord GOD says this: Because you clapped your hands and stamped your feet and rejoiced with a heart full of contempt against the land of Israel,

therefore, behold, I will stretch out My hand against you and give you as plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples and destroy you from the lands. I will annihilate you, and you will know that I am the LORD.”
The Lord GOD says this: Because Moab and Seir said, ‘Look, the house of Judah is like all the other nations,’
therefore, behold, I will expose the flank of Moab, namely its frontier cities, the glory of the land—Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim.
I will give Moab, along with the Ammonites, as a possession to the people of the East, so that the Ammonites will no longer be remembered among the nations.
So I will execute judgments on Moab, and they will know that I am the LORD.’
The Lord GOD says this: Because Edom took vengeance on the house of Judah, and by doing so incurred grievous guilt,
therefore the Lord GOD says this: I will stretch out My hand against Edom and cut off from it both man and beast. I will make it a wasteland, and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.
I will lay My vengeance on Edom by the hand of My people Israel, and they will deal with Edom according to My anger and My wrath. Then they will know My vengeance, declares the Lord GOD.’
The Lord GOD says this: Because the Philistines took vengeance—taking vengeance with a heart of contempt, to destroy Judah with ancient hostility—
therefore the Lord GOD says this: Behold, I will stretch out My hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites and destroy those who remain along the seacoast.
I will execute great vengeance against them with furious punishment. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I lay My vengeance upon them.”
